title: Ginger M NDE 379
content: I was twenty-three years young, vacationing with girlfriends in Florida. Beautiful white sand on a beach that stretched as far as the eye could see. My friends were sunning themselves while I splashed in the sea - it was soothing, wonderful! I was caught in an undertow and tried to swim against it. I'm not an experienced swimmer. Too far out to see the beach, I panicked and tried to swim harder and became very fatigued. There wasn't a soul out there that I could see. I had thoughts of dying all alone - what a shame since I hadn't really lived yet. I was unsure of time and direction. Suddenly I could no longer feel my body, which was weird, since I had been shivering with fear and cold just moments before. I was only aware of an exquisite sense of warmth and peace and the brightest, most golden-white glow enveloped me. Then it felt as if I travelled through a sort of tunnel, and I viewed what looked like brief film clips of my life up to my present age. I could even see expressions on the faces of family members. Next, a man sailing a small boat asked me, 'What seems to be the problem?' And I replied that I was not able to swim to shore. I do not remember getting in his boat, nor do I recall sailing to shore. My memory is only that of waking up on the beach surrounded by the lifeguard and onlookers. I recall being in an ambulance and the paramedic slapping my face, encouraging me to stay awake. I felt bereft! All I wanted was to find that beautiful warm and serene place again and never have to leave it. Some months later, I became interested in the metaphysical. I read about the mystery schools and other religions and philosophies. I was curious about things I never thought to question before.
